## Taxes

### Corporate income taxes

Corporate taxes materialize as lowered wages, increased prices, or reduced profits. It's generally agreed that the first two are bigger effects than the third.[^1][^2]

[^1]:https://home.treasury.gov/system/files/131/wp-101.pdf
[^2]:https://www.nber.org/system/files/working_papers/w27058/w27058.pdf
